          type: string

21	/**
22	 * Normalizes and validates an owner's telephone number on create: every
23	 * non-digit character is stripped and the result is required to be exactly
24	 * {@link #REQUIRED_DIGITS} digits long.
25	 */
26	@Component
27	public class TelephoneNormalizer {
28	
29	    /** The exact number of digits a normalized telephone must contain. */
30	    public static final int REQUIRED_DIGITS = 10;
31	
32	    /**
33	     * Remove every non-digit character from the given telephone.
34	     *
35	     * @param telephone the raw telephone value (may be {@code null})
36	     * @return the digits-only telephone, never {@code null}
37	     */
38	    public String normalize(String telephone) {
39	        return telephone == null ? "" : telephone.replaceAll("\\D", "");
40	    }
41	
42	    /**
43	     * @param normalized a value already produced by {@link #normalize(String)}
44	     * @return {@code true} if it is exactly {@link #REQUIRED_DIGITS} digits long
45	     */
46	    public boolean hasRequiredDigits(String normalized) {
47	        return normalized.length() == REQUIRED_DIGITS;
48	    }

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.

## Summary

I added optional, validated, lower-cased `email` support to pet owners, following the existing `telephone` conventions.

**API contract** (`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`)
- Added an optional `email` string property to the `OwnerFields` schema (inherited by `Owner`), so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` gain `email`. Kept it out of `required`.

**Domain model** (`model/Owner.java`)
- Added an `email` column with getter/setter. MapStruct's `OwnerMapper` now maps it automatically by name in both directions (no mapper change needed).

**Validation/normalization** (`rest/validation/EmailNormalizer.java`, new)
- A small single-responsibility component mirroring `TelephoneNormalizer`: `normalize()` trims + lower-cases (null-safe), `isValid()` checks syntactic validity via a regex.

**Controller** (`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`)
- Injected `EmailNormalizer`. In `addOwner` (POST) and `updateOwner` (PUT): if an email is present and invalid → `400`; otherwise the normalized (lower-cased) value is stored. Absent email stays `null` and is accepted.

**Database schema/seed data**
- Added a nullable `email` column to the `owners` table in all four dialects (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`).
- The column-less `INSERT INTO owners VALUES (...)` seed rows in `hsqldb` and `mysql` `data.sql` would have broken with the new column, so I made those inserts name their columns explicitly (h2 and postgres already did).

Test results: the acceptance suite (`coreLowercasesEmail`, `errorRejectsInvalidEmail`, `functionalityAcceptsMissingEmail`) passes — `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` and `BUILD SUCCESS`.
